description: This file defines the GenericProvider class, which is a general-purpose OAuth2 service provider implementation. It extends AbstractProvider and uses BearerAuthorizationTrait. The class manages OAuth2 configuration options, URL endpoints, and response handling for interacting with any OAuth2 provider. It provides methods for retrieving authorization URLs, access tokens, and resource owner details, along with configuration validation.

classes.name: GenericProvider
classes.description: A flexible OAuth2 service provider class capable of interfacing with various OAuth2 providers by configurable URLs and options. Implements URL retrieval, response validation, and resource owner creation functionalities.

methods.name: getConfigurableOptions
methods.description: Returns an array of configuration options that can be customized for this provider.

methods.name: getRequiredOptions
methods.description: Returns an array of configuration options that are mandatory for this provider.

methods.name: assertRequiredOptions
methods.description: Checks that all required options are present and throws an exception if any are missing.

methods.name: getBaseAuthorizationUrl
methods.description: Provides the URL for the OAuth2 authorization endpoint.

methods.name: getBaseAccessTokenUrl
methods.description: Provides the URL for the access token endpoint.

methods.name: getResourceOwnerDetailsUrl
methods.description: Provides the URL to retrieve resource owner details.

methods.name: getDefaultScopes
methods.description: Returns the default scopes for the OAuth2 request.

methods.name: getAccessTokenMethod
methods.description: Returns the HTTP method used to obtain the access token.

methods.name: getAccessTokenResourceOwnerId
methods.description: Returns the parameter key for resource owner ID.

methods.name: getScopeSeparator
methods.description: Returns the character used to separate scopes.

methods.name: getPkceMethod
methods.description: Returns the PKCE method used, if any.

methods.name: checkResponse
methods.description: Validates the response data for errors and throws an exception if necessary.

methods.name: createResourceOwner
methods.description: Creates a resource owner object from API response data.
